name: Octen

env_keys.comment: API keys and configuration variables documented by the provider.

python_extra.comment: Optional PyPI package: octen (install via anysearch-sdk extra `octen`).

requires_key.comment: Valid API key required for every request.

snippet.comment: Short description field returned with each result.

safe_search.comment: `safesearch` accepts `off` or `strict`; anysearch moderate maps to strict.

mode.comment: POST `/search` exposes one Web Search tier. Octen's separate Broad Search and Deep Research endpoints are not mapped to the unified `mode` parameter.

pricing_per_1k.value: Promotional Web Search $1 / 1K (normally $5), includes 10 full-content results; +$0.50 / 1K extra results
pricing_per_1k.comment: Units and commitments differ; do not rank these as equivalent flat per-query prices.

primary_price.basis: Normally $5; ten full-content results included; expansion extra

free_tier_limits.comment: Trial, monthly credits and model-tool promotions are distinct.

p50_latency.value: Historical July 2026: Web Search: 62 ms p50; 68 ms p90
p50_latency.comment: Historical evidence retained from July 2026; not remeasured or claimed current. Provider-reported March 2026 result. Octen publishes 62 ms p50; the 68 ms p90 comes from an archived screenshot/OCR record. No independent API rerun was found.

notes: Native SDK package: octen. Web Search (`POST /search`) is wired in both anysearch SDKs. The published 62 ms p50 is a provider claim, not an independently reproduced benchmark.

native_api.value: Search 1–100 results; domain/language/date/safe-search, content/highlights. Broad mode bills per generated subquery. 62ms p50 is a vendor claim, not a guarantee.

rate_limits.value: $5 minimum top-up; 10 QPS free, up to 20 after top-up; QPS subscription excludes usage

checked_at.comment: Official public documentation reviewed; no paid API or benchmark run.

capability_basis.comment: SDK availability is separate from native provider capability. Each native feature cell carries its own checked date and evidence.

sdk_support.comment: SDK adapter availability only. See Capability basis for the feature rows; native features do not imply an SDK adapter.
